value.rationale: Induced forest is the complement of a minimum feedback vertex set, a natural NP-hard graph invariant. This completes the natural k=2 Kneser family at the first crossover n=7, identifies exactly where 7-point nonstar optima beat or tie stars, and describes all optimum reconfiguration components. Explicit disconnected cliques reveal an obstruction to local exchange search; the exceptional coexistence is a structural phenomenon, not an arbitrary isolated computation.
